brief:
Israeli affairs specialist Maamoun Abu Amer told Shehab Wire that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is using evasive tactics to protect his right-wing electoral agenda through his publicly stated positions on fifteen points contained in an agreement signed in Cairo between the "Peace Council" and other Palestinian factions.

Abu Amer's analysis suggests Netanyahu is deliberately avoiding clear commitments on the accord's specific terms while maintaining political backing from his coalition's right-wing members. The prime minister's approach appears designed to preserve support from hardline allies without taking definitive stances that could complicate his electoral standing ahead of upcoming elections.
title: Netanyahu maneuvers on Cairo agreement, avoiding clarity on key points
